title: Light unit quiz with ray diagrams
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 26 (Light unit quiz with ray diagrams (portal worksheet with answer key))
intro: Covers lessons 1 to 26 of Light theory. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Why is the light blocked when one card moves?
options: Light only travels in straight lines
questions.a: B) Light only travels in straight lines. Light cannot bend through a hole that is out of line.

questions.q: A ray hits a mirror at 40° to the normal. It reflects at...
questions.a: B) 40°. Angle of reflection equals angle of incidence.

questions.q: Which makes the darkest shadow?
questions.a: B) Card. Card is opaque and blocks all the light.

questions.q: Why does the coin appear when water is poured in?
options: Light bends at the surface towards your eye
questions.a: B) Light bends at the surface towards your eye. Refraction bends the light over the cup edge into your eye.

questions.q: Make the pinhole bigger. The image gets...
questions.a: A) Brighter but blurrier. More light gets in, but rays overlap, so it is brighter and blurrier.

questions.q: If the top mirror is tilted to 30°, what happens?
options: The ray misses the bottom mirror
questions.a: B) The ray misses the bottom mirror. The angle changes the ray's path, so it no longer travels straight down the tube.

questions.q: Which way do the arrows go in a 'how we see' diagram?
options: From the eye to the object
From the source to the object to the eye
From the object to the source
questions.a: B) From the source to the object to the eye. Light starts at the source, reflects off the object and enters the eye.

questions.q: The torch moves from 40 cm to 10 cm. The shadow...
questions.a: A) Gets bigger. Closer to the source, the object blocks more of the spreading light.

questions.q: Which colour bends the most?
questions.a: C) Violet. Violet is bent the most and red the least, which is why they sit at opposite ends.

questions.q: Through a red filter, a blue book looks...
questions.a: C) Black. The filter lets only red through; the book reflects no red, so it looks black.

questions.q: Ibn al-Haytham showed that we see because...
questions.a: B) Light enters our eyes. His experiments showed light travels from objects into the eye.

questions.q: Which diagram is correct for seeing a cup?
options: Arrow from lamp to cup to eye
questions.a: B) Arrow from lamp to cup to eye. Light goes from the source, reflects off the cup and enters the eye.

questions.q: Is the Moon a light source?
questions.a: No, it reflects the Sun's light

questions.q: Which material lets light through: opaque or transparent?
questions.a: Transparent

questions.q: Light travels in...
questions.a: Straight lines

questions.q: A pinhole image is...
questions.a: Upside down

questions.q: Angle of reflection equals angle of...
questions.a: Incidence

questions.q: Light bending into water is...
questions.a: Refraction

questions.q: A shadow forms when light is...
questions.a: Blocked

questions.q: Which part of the eye focuses light?
questions.a: Lens
